title: Workspace Switch + Read-Only Path
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: workspace-switcher.ts 支持 master/conductor/performer 之间切换
AC-2: readonly-path.ts 标识 readonly 路径 (miao/*, .git/hooks/*, .kallax/config/*)
AC-3: state.json 包含 current_workspace + readonly_paths[] 字段
AC-4: kallax workspace:switch <name> 切换 workspace (验证权限)
AC-5: kallax workspace:readonly <path> 标记路径为 readonly
AC-6: 切换到 readonly workspace 后写入被拒绝 (exit 1 + 审计)
AC-7: realpath 执行顺序在前 (防 symlink 绕过)
AC-8: session_start.sh 启动时验证 cwd ∈ worktree/
AC-9: L1 存在性: ls src/permissions/workspace-switcher.ts + readonly-path.ts
AC-10: L2 实质性: wc -c 每个 .ts > 300 bytes
AC-11: L3 接线正确: npx tsc --noEmit 无错误
AC-12: L4 数据流动: 切到 readonly workspace, 验证写入被拒 (exit 1)
AC-13: 跨 workspace 切换审计日志 (from_role, to_role, timestamp)
p0_fixes: realpath 执行顺序在前 (防 symlink 绕过)
workspace 切换需要 auditor+ role
